feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: In one of their last votes before November, Senate GOP blocks effort to end Iran war
entry.summary: The vote on a war powers resolution introduced by Democrats came at a moment when some Republicans have begun to distance themselves from President Trump over the ongoing conflict.

entry.title: 'Bad Boy For Life' investigates the culture that enabled Sean Combs' alleged abuse
entry.summary: Rolling Stone reporter Cheyenne Roundtree says rumors of abuse followed the media mogul for years. Her book examines how Combs remained so powerful, despite decades of warning signs and allegations.

entry.title: Mahershala Ali stars as a devout father of three, making ends meet as a hitman
entry.summary: It's not easy, killing people and raising a family. The new action-thriller Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother reaffirms the power of faith — and delights in outrageous juxtapositions.

entry.title: RFK Jr.'s ethics filing reveals book deals worth millions of dollars
entry.summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s annual financial disclosure reveals he has received two lucrative book advances and free flights from a friend while in office.

entry.title: Mortgage rates have just surpassed 7% for the first time in well over a year
entry.summary: Rates have climbed more than a full percentage point since the U.S. war against Iran started.

entry.title: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
entry.summary: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.

entry.title: 'Empire' asks: When a child dies, who pays the price?
entry.summary: Set in the same universe as Tahir's Ember in Ashes series, Empire picks up right where the last book, 'Heir' left off — with S'rsha attached to the very monster she sought to destroy.

entry.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit amid underlying tensions
entry.summary: Despite the pageantry and the cordial tone, expectations for any big breakthroughs on issues ranging from AI to Iran to a trade war truce are low.

entry.title: Needy couples got cash and a spending plan. Results were good -- and bad
entry.summary: In Liberia, joint financial planning boosted cash aid's benefits. It also had an unexpected consequence for some families.

entry.title: These 6 charts show how NIH research funding has been reshaped under Trump
entry.summary: Stories of science funding being cut, labs shutting down and scientists losing jobs have flooded the media under Trump's administration. These six graphics show how those changes have affected U.S. biomedical research.
